cards.title: Software Documentation and Electronic Submission Standards
cards.claim: Submissions must include the name and version of the software, schematic views of model structures, mathematical equations, parameterization sources, and user manuals. Electronic files must comply with eCTD specifications.
conditions: FDA does not recommend specific software; sponsors must communicate early if using complex models.
Documentation must describe how software vendor changes during development impacted model performance.
Electronic files must adhere to eCTD file format specifications and technical rejection criteria.
required_inputs: Schematic view of model structure and mathematical equations.
Parameterization of system information and sources of parameter values.
limitations: Does not validate specific software tools.
Does not provide technical details on eCTD file formats beyond referencing external specifications.
cards.downstream_use: Ensuring the technical reproducibility and auditability of the simulation environment.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
